discoveries.title: MagicHOI only_3d uses Zero123, NOT depths
discoveries.body: Stage-1 SDF non-convergence is not caused by zero-stub depth maps. only_3d takes do_3d_guidance_only=True, which routes through zero123_guidance.py:99/324 and skips both visibility_binarys (depth) and visibility_colors (RGB recon). Depths are only consumed in stage-2 align_corres.py via --query_depth_f. Replacing zero stubs with Metric3D depths won't unblock model.obj. See project_magichoi_only3d_zero123_finding.md.

discoveries.title: v13 patches: makedirs + None-safety
discoveries.body: Two inline patches in scripts/acp/acp_magichoi_diag_startup.sh let MagicHOI's stage-1 export write camera.json even when SDF is degenerate: run.py::export_cond_cam now os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(cam_f), exist_ok=True), and threestudio/models/mesh.py::remove_outlier returns self when max_comp is None. The downstream amin() on empty v_pos still raises IndexError but run.py's `|| true` swallows it; ACP exit 0.

discoveries.title: Truncated wheels look intact at the start
discoveries.body: Prior session's torch wheel scp left 2,251,915,264 bytes (vs correct 2,267,322,772). File starts with PK\x04\x03 (valid local header) so it looks like a zip, but unzip -t says 'End-of-central-directory signature not found'. pip install rejects with 'Wheel ... is invalid'. Always verify wheels with zipfile.testzip() before pip install.

discoveries.title: droid.pth is the small fnet-only variant
discoveries.body: User-supplied droid.pth is 16,061,701 bytes (~16 MB, 4M params), much smaller than the typical full DROID-SLAM checkpoint (~287 MB). torch.load returns OrderedDict with module.fnet.* keys — appears to be the recurrent-backbone subset HaWoR's hawor_slam.py needs, not the full DROID.
